items.title: How Could Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) New AI Push Expand Its Market?
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems (NasdaqGS:CDNS) introduced its Maestro AI Model Portfolio, a suite of AI agents for chip and system design workflows.
